baseline_models.mechanism: The focus verse presents a causal sequence: gentle direction toward a straight and practically sound course reaches trusting assent, with fa- marking belief as the hearers' immediate response to what the discourse does.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward a way supplies both the guiding action and its non-coercive mode.
A straight course away from error supplies the destination's directional shape.
Sound handling of an affair makes the destination practical judgment, not information alone.
Heart-settling confirmation supplies the receptive result of being guided.

changed_reading.before: The discourse contains correct instruction, and the hearers then believe it.
changed_reading.after: The discourse performs a directional act: it leads the hearers into a straight, practically sound course, and trusting assent follows as its immediate uptake.

baseline_models.mechanism: The irreversible pledge removes every sharer from relation to 'our Lord': authority, nurture, and lasting allegiance are not divisible, while ahadan exhausts the class of possible partners.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust make the following pledge a stable allegiance rather than a momentary opinion.
Sharing and partnership provide the relation that the pledge categorically refuses.
Association with God fixes the refused partnership in the theological register of the clause.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the domain that cannot be shared.
Repair, nurture, and completion make exclusive lordship formative as well as sovereign.
Exhaustive 'anyone' under negation closes every possible exception to the pledge.

changed_reading.before: The converts promise not to worship another deity.
changed_reading.after: Their new trust becomes undivided allegiance: no claimant may share the authority, nurture, or completion belonging to their Lord.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus branches permit a movement model: guidance establishes intended direction and a straight course, while shirk evokes rival ruts, a snare, and a divided mind. The pledge protects the route of rushd from capture by competing tracks or allegiances.

activation_trace.role: Course, manner, and intended direction turn guidance into sustained orientation.
The straight course supplies the viable route toward which the hearers are turned.
Path ruts provide the image of rival tracks competing with the course of rushd.
A hunter's snare makes partnership a form of capture that arrests directed movement.
A divided or preoccupied mind supplies the inward counterpart to competing external tracks.

changed_reading.before: Belief and non-association are two adjacent declarations.
changed_reading.after: Non-association is also the route consequence of guidance: straightened direction displaces rival tracks, snares, and divided attention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah supplies the object and reception event omitted by the focus: a divinely disclosed recitation is deliberately heard, understood, and recognized as unfamiliar. The focus's guiding and believing clauses are therefore the effect phase of a concrete auditory encounter.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction names what the heard discourse does after reception.
Trusting confirmation supplies the encounter's resulting uptake.
A report or inspiration from God supplies the discourse's hidden sending source.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception more than acoustic contact.
Gathering and collection give the heard material coherence as a discourse.
Reading and recitation provide the audible vehicle by which the gathered discourse reaches them.
Wonder at an unfamiliar matter marks the expectation-breaking recognition that opens the changed reading.

structural_cues: 72:1 immediately supplies a heard Qur'an and the speakers' report before the focus verse.
The singular pronoun in bihi follows the indefinite Qur'an across the ayah boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed disclosure, deliberate hearing, recitation, and wonder; I infer that this reception chain mediates the focus's guidance-to-faith arrow. A live alternative is that bihi points to guidance itself rather than specifically to the recited Qur'an.

changed_reading.before: A proposition about guidance is followed by belief.
changed_reading.after: A surprising recited disclosure is heard into understanding, performs guidance, and elicits trusting assent in one reception event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pledge now opposes an epistemic and social system: reckless overreaching speech about God and falsehood support human recourse to jinn patrons, while that refuge relation increases oppressive burden. Faith in the Lord transfers trust away from both false claims and surrogate protection.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust provide the replacement for unreliable speech and refuge.
Partnership supplies the relational category instantiated by outsourcing protection.
Lordship and authority identify the sole locus to which trust is transferred.
Saying or attributing what was not supplies the false-claim mechanism about God.
Lightness of mind and deficient forbearance characterize the speaker generating those claims.
Deviation and injustice away from truth give the speech its directional opposition to rushd.
The opposite of truth names the failed assumption on which the old trust system rested.
Seeking shelter and protection supplies the practical dependency that functions like partnership.
Increase and growth provide the explicit causal escalation produced by the refuge relation.
Oppressive burden and overtaxing name what the surrogate protection actually increases.

structural_cues: 72:4-5 pair overreaching speech with the speakers' former assumption that humans and jinn would not lie about God.
72:6 repeats 'men' on both sides of the refuge relation and uses fa- to connect refuge with increased rahaq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false God-talk, refuge in jinn patrons, and an explicit increase in burden; I infer that practical reliance is one social form of the partnership rejected in 72:2. Alternatively, the refuge episode may illustrate error without exhausting the wider scope of shirk.

changed_reading.before: The pledge rejects an abstract theological error.
changed_reading.after: The pledge dismantles a lived protection economy: false authorities and patrons are abandoned because their promised refuge deepens the burden that trust sought to escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The former practice of seeking the sky from fixed listening stations now meets surveillance and leaves the speakers admitting that they do not know what is intended on earth. Against that failed acquisition mode, the focus depicts guidance as an openly heard discourse that yields accountable trust rather than possession of hidden intelligence.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction toward truth contrasts with extracting inaccessible information.
Sound judgment supplies an action-guiding result even where hidden intention remains unknown.
Settled trust is the alternative epistemic posture to covert information capture.
Seeking and feeling for something makes contact with the sky an attempted acquisition.
Sitting in wait to monitor supplies the fixed surveillance posture of the former listeners.
Auditory perception names the channel being pursued and lets it contrast with hearing-as-understanding in 72:1.
Watching and guarding close the old listening route and reverse observer into observed.
Knowledge and awareness, explicitly negated in the ayah, mark the limit of the failed acquisition mode.

structural_cues: 72:8-9 moves from seeking contact with the sky to former listening seats and a present guard.
72:10 begins with 'we do not know' before contrasting evil with Lord-intended rushd.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted contact, listening stations, guards, and admitted non-knowledge; I infer a contrast between captured intelligence and received guidance. A live alternative is that the sky scene reports a changed condition without morally classifying every earlier act of listening.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gives the hearers privileged information about hidden affairs.
changed_reading.after: Guidance does not make them owners of hidden intelligence; it gives enough orientation for trust and sound action while their confession of non-knowledge remains intact.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayah 72:13 nearly replays the focus's hearing-guidance-belief sequence, then unfolds the security latent in aman: trust in the Lord is not exposed to anticipated terror, diminished due, or crushing imposition. The reprise confirms the causal chain and gives its settled trust a non-extractive social texture.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust in the focus are the semantic potential that the reprise expands.
Nurture and completion make the Lord relation compatible with protection from loss and overburdening.
Hearing as understanding and compliance restarts the same reception chain explicitly.
Gentle direction toward truth names what is heard and directly echoes the focus's guiding verb.
Settled security and trust bind the repeated belief response to its stated consequences.
Dread of an expected harm supplies the affective condition that faithful trust removes.
Diminution of right or worth specifies the extractive loss that the believer need not fear.
Oppressive overburdening supplies the second harm excluded from the trust relation.

structural_cues: The sequence 'when we heard the guidance, we believed in it' closely reprises 72:1-2.
The singular believer clause then coordinates no bakhs and no rahaq under no fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact reception reprise followed by three harm terms; I infer that these terms unpack the security component of iman in the focus. Alternatively, the assurance may be eschatological without describing the believers' immediate psychology or social conditions.

changed_reading.before: Belief is assent to correct guidance.
changed_reading.after: Belief is settled trust in a Lord whose guidance neither cheats the hearer of due nor crushes the hearer with added burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated rushd clauses distribute agency: the Lord may intend rushd for people, those who hand themselves over deliberately seek it, and the messenger denies possessing it for others. The focus's Qur'an guides toward a divinely intended orientation that hearers must enter, not a benefit controlled and dispensed at human will.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction supplies mediation toward rushd without implying human ownership of it.
Sound judgment in handling an affair identifies the practical orientation whose agency is redistributed.
Will and intention make rushd an intended outcome amid the speakers' uncertainty.
Sound handling names the good orientation that the ayah attributes to the Lord's intent.
Handing over and relinquishing supply the receptive posture from which rushd is deliberately sought.
Practical soundness becomes the explicit object of the seekers' effort.
Ownership and power of disposal, here negated, deny that the speaker controls outcomes for the audience.
Harm and diminution supply the negative pole paired with rushd under denied possession.
The same practical soundness is explicitly not something the messenger owns for others.

structural_cues: 72:10 contrasts uncertain evil with the Lord's intending rushd.
The branchless root ح ر ي at 72:14 makes rushd the object of deliberate seeking and is used only as a structural cue.
72:21 pairs harm and rushd under the messenger's denial of possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, deliberate search, and denied possession around repeated rushd; I infer that these clauses separate divine source, receptive pursuit, and messenger control. Alternatively, 72:21 may deny power to cause the outcomes rather than treating rushd as something figuratively owned.

changed_reading.before: The messenger or text hands over a finished package called right guidance.
changed_reading.after: The discourse points into Lord-intended soundness that hearers must seek and inhabit, while the messenger expressly lacks autonomous control over that outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's directional branches expand into a route ecology: plural paths are cut apart, one way can be made straight, that alignment opens abundant water, abundance itself tests, and turning one's side away results in being inserted into an uphill hardship. Rushd is thus a traversed and tested orientation, not a static label or an automatic prosperity signal.

activation_trace.role: Course, manner, and intended direction provide the focus anchor for the expanded route system.
A straight course away from error supplies the normative geometry of the route.
Path ruts give non-association a spatial role as refusal of competing tracks.
An extended route supplies the common material for the speakers' plural paths.
Divergent paths and groups make the route field visibly split rather than uniform.
Straightness, balance, and level alignment supply the condition applied to the way.
The extended path gives the straightened condition a traversable object.
Giving drink supplies the causal provision released upon route alignment.
Ordinary water provides the material medium of that provision.
Abundance of water and provision marks the route's apparently favorable yield.
Testing metal or a person reverses abundance from final reward into an assay of response.
Turning one's side away provides the bodily deviation that breaks route alignment.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the counter-routing into hardship.
A difficult ascent gives the adverse route its resistant gradient.

structural_cues: 72:11 names the speakers as divided paths; 72:16 conditions abundant water on straightness upon the path.
72:17 immediately states a testing purpose, then contrasts turning away with being made to enter ascending hardship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split paths, straightness, provision, testing, lateral turning, insertion, and ascent; I infer one functional route system linking them. A live alternative is that water is literal provision and the later punishment is a separate consequence rather than part of a shared spatial analogy.

changed_reading.before: Guidance identifies the correct path and prosperity confirms arrival.
changed_reading.after: Guidance establishes a traversable orientation through divided tracks; even abundant provision tests that orientation, while turning aside produces a resistant counter-route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ayat 72:18-20 enact the focus pledge in address and worship: places of prostration are assigned to God, calling anyone alongside God is barred, and the servant's own crowded act is to call his Lord without association. Exclusive allegiance governs the destination of invocation even amid intense social plurality.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority identify the exclusive addressee of the later call.
Association with God supplies the focus prohibition that the later speech repeats in practice.
Exhaustive anyone under negation leaves no secondary destination for invocation.
A place of prostration supplies the cultic setting in which exclusivity is exercised.
Calling and inclining by speech provide the concrete act that must remain undivided.
Exhaustive anyone extends the focus's no-exception pledge into the prohibition on co-calling.
Submissive worship identifies the caller through enacted obedience rather than autonomous power.
A dense mass piled layer upon layer supplies the crowding social pressure around the undivided call.
The speaker's own calling turns the prohibition into a first-person practice.
Lordship and authority specify the one addressee of that practice.
Association with God is again explicitly denied, echoing the focus pledge.
Exhaustive anyone closes the repeated first-person denial without exception.

structural_cues: 72:18 moves from God's claim over the masajid directly to a ban on calling anyone with God.
72:19 places a densely gathered crowd around the servant's call, and 72:20 repeats the focus's Lord-shirk-anyone wording in the first person.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prostration space, exclusive calling, servant worship, crowding, and a near-verbatim first-person denial; I infer that the focus pledge governs invocation under social pressure. Alternatively, da'wa may include proclamation as well as prayer, so the model should not reduce every occurrence to ritual petition.

changed_reading.before: Non-association is an inward creed or a count of deities.
changed_reading.after: Non-association is performed by keeping address, prostration, and allegiance directed to one Lord even when many bodies crowd around the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence distinguishes a rival from a dependent envoy. There is no independent refuge from God, yet hidden knowledge may be disclosed to an approved messenger; the messenger is inserted within guards, delivery reaches its goal, and the whole relay is encompassed and enumerated. The focus rejects co-lordship without erasing authorized mediation under the Lord's control.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority provide the sovereign pole under which the relay operates.
Sharing and partnership name the independent status denied to every intermediary.
Exhaustive anyone closes the field of rival protectors while leaving the later exception structurally dependent.
Protection through neighborhood or pledged shelter, here denied, removes any independent protector from God.
Turning toward a refuge supplies the side-exit that the speaker says he cannot find.
Conveying a message supplies the permitted task remaining after autonomous refuge and power are denied.
Messenger and message define mediation as an assigned relation rather than shared sovereignty.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the protected content whose disclosure remains sovereign.
Emergence and disclosure provide the controlled movement of hidden content into manifestation.
Approval rather than displeasure supplies the selection condition for the messenger exception.
The messenger is the approved relay role, not a co-owner of the hidden.
Insertion of one thing within another makes the guards an enclosing arrangement around the relay.
Watching and guarding supply active supervision of the messenger's transmission corridor.
Conveying the messages marks completion of the assigned relay rather than acquisition of sovereignty.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and control closes the relay within divine oversight.
Exhaustive enumeration makes oversight auditable down to every item.
Counting the counted supplies the final image of nothing in the relay escaping account.

structural_cues: 72:26-27 frames disclosure as an exception for an approved messenger rather than a general opening of the unseen.
The guard is placed before the messenger and behind him, followed by delivery, encompassing, and counting in 72:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no refuge, an approved-messenger exception, surrounding guards, completed delivery, and total accounting; I infer that exclusive lordship excludes independent rivals but permits dependent mediation. Alternatively, the guards may protect the message, attest delivery, or do both, and the packet does not settle that directional function.

changed_reading.before: Refusing every partner means that no mediation can stand between the Lord and hearers.
changed_reading.after: Refusing partners distinguishes rival agency from authorized relay: a messenger may carry disclosed guidance precisely because selection, route, protection, and accounting remain under one Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the gift branch of h-d-y under a guiding verb; it remains anchored in yahdi and coheres with settled aman and nurturing rabb. Downstream prose should present it as a relational branch resonance, not replace the verb's ordinary guidance sense with 'gives a gift.'

activation_trace.role: A gracious gift sent to someone close makes guidance relationally offered rather than merely commanded.
Settled security and trust supply the inward reception of that gracious offering.
Nurture and completion identify the giver relation to which the pledge answers.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an instruction that wins assent.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can also be heard as a gracious relational offering whose reception settles trust and elicits exclusive loyalty to the nurturing Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-d mapping for the focus occurrence of h-d-y; it remains formally anchored by that explicit split mapping and gains focus coherence from the rejected partnership structure. Downstream prose must label it an exploratory activation or material analogy, never a translation or etymological claim.

activation_trace.role: Collapse and severe breaking supply an exploratory destructive phase within the guiding event.
Partnership supplies the prior relational structure imagined as being broken apart.
The straight course supplies the viable orientation that becomes available after that break.

changed_reading.before: Guidance only points toward a better course.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the guiding encounter first breaks the inherited architecture of shared allegiance so that a straight course can be entered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant r-b-w target supplied for rabb; it remains anchored by the same focus occurrence and is stabilized by the dominant rabb branch of nurture and completion. Downstream prose should qualify growth as a secondary split-root resonance, not identify rabb lexically with r-b-w.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion establish the dominant formative sense of the Lord relation.
Nurture and growing up add an exploratory image of development under a single source.
Partnership supplies the rival formative claim excluded from that developmental relation.

changed_reading.before: The pledge recognizes one sovereign owner.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pledge also entrusts growth and completion to one formative source and refuses rival claims over what the hearers are becoming.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the effect phase of a heard, surprising revelation event rather than a detached proposition.
The near-verbatim reprise in 72:13 confirms the hearing-guidance-belief chain and unfolds iman as protection from dread, diminution, and oppressive burden.
Repeated rushd distributes agency among divine intention, human seeking, and the messenger's lack of autonomous possession.
Path, water, testing, lateral turning, insertion, and difficult ascent turn guidance into a route maintained under both provision and pressure.
The no-partner pledge becomes both a break from false protection networks and an enacted discipline of undivided invocation.
Exclusive lordship remains compatible with an approved, guarded, and fully audited messenger relay because mediation is dependent rather than rival.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reintroduced the focus's own roots in altered functional settings: hearing became understanding, aman became non-extractive security, rushd became intended yet sought and unowned, and shirk moved from doctrine into refuge, route, and invocation. Split mappings also exposed contained but live gift, breaking, and growth resonances that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of bihi can be heard as the Qur'an, the guidance, or their fused event.
The route-provision-test model may join literal consequences through one analogy more tightly than the syntax requires.
The range of da'wa in 72:18-20 may include proclamation as well as ritual petition.
The guards in 72:27 may protect transmission, attest delivery, or perform both functions.
The gift, h-d-d breaking, and r-b-w growth outliers are branch activations and must not be promoted into lexical translations.
